title: Add task approval follow-up regression eval UI and no-actuation suite

gates.name: task approval follow-up regression suite
gates.command: pytest backend/tests/tasks backend/tests/approvals backend/tests/outcomes backend/tests/agent_harness backend/tests/integration backend/tests/security

verify: FT-013 regression suite covers all task, approval, action_task, outcome, publication, and no-actuation verification targets.
Harness evals cover unknown tool, invalid args, prompt injection, stale approval, mismatched proposal, governance substitution, and false success claims.
UI/e2e smoke covers pending approval, rejected approval no action_task, approved human-performed action_task, and follow-up outcome capture when UI exists.
No automated actuation command, tool, external side effect, or device execution path exists.
evidence_required: UI/e2e smoke evidence when UI exists
T3 human checkpoint and rollback/recovery note before closure
constraints: Test-only mocks may be used in automated tests but cannot satisfy runtime/demo acceptance where real model-backed behavior is required.
Approval-sensitive commits require backend policy checks and approval records.
No task or approval triggers automated device execution in MVP.
invariants: T3 closure requires verify PASS, red-verify semantic-pass, human checkpoint, and rollback/recovery note.
Approved physical actions create only human-performed action_task records.
Follow-up outcomes preserve evidence and audit trail.
verification_targets: follow-up outcome evidence and no_data semantics
